title.narrative: Mano River Union Regional Advocacy Strategy

description.narrative:
The Mano River Regional Strategy (MRU) sets out the broad direction for the Connect programme over the medium term. However there is room in the strategy for more detailed work – specifically on advocacy. It is especially important now to set out what CAFOD see as the key directions for policy influencing as partners are looking to CAFOD for support in this area. As Liberia and Sierra Leone are both countries emerging from conflict there is the need to look at how the civil society sector can be developed as a whole to effectively represent the citizens of these countries. All work also needs to be based on a firm and solid understanding of the social context and political trends in the two countries.
CAFOD has on-going work on advocacy through the Connect programme. However in order to develop these strategies further an advocacy plan will be needed. This will set out how CAFOD can engage in the above strategies through and beyond the Connect programme. In order to do this a more comprehensive picture of the context and the background needs to be developed to ensure the plan accurately reflects the context and responds in the most appropriate manner. A consultant will be given the responsibility to conduct a detailed research aimed at helping the program to develop a better understanding of the context and a starting point for conversations with partners and review plans to engage policy stakeholder.
Following the consultants report, a detailed discussion will be held through workshop sessions with CAFOD and partner staff facilitated by CAFOD’s Senior Advocacy accompanier to develop an MRU advocacy which will direct the country office advocacy work for the next three years and beyond
